posts.title: Crash! Boom! Bang!
posts.excerpt: Analysing traffic incidents across Okinawa, Japan in the year 2024 to see where accidents clustered, when they peaked, and which patterns stood out in fatal crashes.

posts.title: The Monster Tail Experiment
posts.excerpt: I used earthquake data to see how to tell a Pareto tail from an exponential one. It turns out the answer depends on what you're measuring.

posts.title: The Geography of Gun Violence in New York City
posts.excerpt: I looked at 19 years of recorded shootings in New York City to see when they peaked and whether the late-night weekend map told a different story.

posts.title: COVID-19: The Latecomer's Advantage?
posts.excerpt: Did countries that reported COVID-19 later see slower growth in confirmed cases? I compared the first 45 days of reported cases across 197 countries.
